integrity: Proof and recurrence-based reproducibility checked; scientific originality and value are same-model reviewed, not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only classical Fibonacci residues modulo products of powers of 7 and 11; proof uses parity-synchronized local isometries and square-root fibers. General moduli not covered. Computational checks sample finite exponents; literature equivalence cannot be ruled out completely.
title: Exact composite Fibonacci fibers modulo \(7^a11^b\) and their nonmultiplicative density
